summary: A Dubai clinic in Oud Metha appears to lose bookings because the booking form looks incomplete and the offers section is empty.

findings.problem: The booking form appears to show only time and reason fields with no name or phone fields, and Schedule Appointment appears to be an email link.
findings.cost: Patients cannot easily book, so they call a competitor.
findings.fix: A complete on page booking form.

findings.problem: Our Offers appears to promise limited time deals but lists no offers.
findings.cost: Empty promises weaken trust and miss a chance to convert.
findings.fix: Real offers with prices and dates, or remove the section.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say All right reserved, and headings such as Need Help ? and Listen from our happy patients appear.
findings.cost: Typos make a clinic look careless.

findings.problem: No dentist is named in the clinic's own copy, and several image labels appear to be filenames.
findings.cost: Patients choose the dentist they can see and trust.
findings.fix: Named dentists with credentials and correct image labels.
